name: baby-blue-slime-rested-cannot-activate-again
notes: Baby Blue Slime (9ggfiy38t2, WATER ALLY, TAMER/ANIMAL/SLIME, reserve 2, POWER 1 / LIFE 2): "[Class Bonus] CARDNAME gets +1 LIFE. [REST]: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to another target Slime ally you control this turn." Baby Blue Slime is played for real from hand (FSM play + 2 reserve payments); WATER is unlocked by patching a Nico lineage into the champion and the deck is colorless so no fast-spell windows interrupt the flow. FIXED ENGINE BUG context: the REST body used to be registered in $cardActivatedAbilities (the play-effect dictionary) with a 0 ability count, so merely PLAYING Baby Blue Slime queued a free target prompt (no REST paid) and the ability could never be activated later; it is now a real $activateAbilityAbilities["9ggfiy38t2:0"] with a prereq and the ally auto-rest as the [REST] cost. Negative path (cost): [REST] can only be paid by an awake ally. Baby Blue Slime is activated once (main phase) to shield the first Red Slime; a second activation attempt in the same turn, with a second legal Red Slime still available, does nothing: no target prompt, no second shield and Baby Blue Slime stays rested.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to another target Slime ally you control this turn.
